title: Grateful Dead Live at US Festival, Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05
venue: US Festival, Glen Helen Regional Park
lineage: Master Cassettes (JVC KD-A55 w/Super ANRS) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (.wav 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition 2024 > TLH 2496
source: Ken Kelley's Master Audience Cassettes; Shure SM-57 mics > JVC KD-2 w/Super ANRS (Maxell XLII-S90)

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture using classic SM57 mics of a concise, 60s‑style set at an ’80s festival.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its use of Shure SM57 microphones – the same workhorse mics that captured classic Dead drum sounds – delivering a clear and surprisingly warm room‑tape sound from the board. The show itself was brief but energetic enough to evoke the band’s ’60s vibe amid a modern festival lineup. Overall it’s a solid listening experience despite the minimalist mic setup.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review highlights a decent performance and a good‑enough soundboard recording; limited data leads to low confidence but overall rating leans positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded with Shure SM57 cardioids (room tapes from the board); clear enough and warm, though not high‑end studio quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short set due to limited time, but maintains a classic Dead vibe that fit the festival atmosphere.
